title: Canonical semilinear compact-support coefficient transport
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite normed extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with an embedding $i:E\to F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site of each scheme $W$, use the completed coefficient rings and strict systems of the ordinary derived evaluation calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The coefficient at index $n\in\mathbf N$ is $(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$, with its actual adjacent quotient map. The same-index quotient inclusions induced by $i$ commute with all transitions, and define exact restriction of full semilinear systems. Use the actual K-flat scalar adjunction of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define whole-system compact support as exact open extension followed by separately derived proper image, using [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. Its coefficient restriction square is the proper mate of the sectionwise identity restriction/direct-image square followed by the open-unit mate; define its scalar projection as the scalar-adjunction mate of that restriction square. The ordinary restriction/limit comparison is uniquely fixed by all strict-tower projections. Derive it with the actual total-limit unit on all complexes, retaining that universal-unit equation, to obtain the normalized whole-system limit/restriction isomorphism. Use the residue-normalized completed coefficient map of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Define the balancing isomorphism between reduction after completed scalar extension and semilinear scalar extension after reduction as the unique left-adjoint comparison conjugate to this limit/restriction isomorphism. All these maps are on entire derived semilinear systems before evaluation, with no flatness hypothesis on same-index quotient inclusions.
